title: Implement PC-aligned application center and isolated account list
acceptance_criteria: Bottom navigation exposes Application Center and Account List using the same mental model as the PC client
Selecting a platform creates or opens a named account instance and each accepted instance has an isolated runtime boundary
Inside an account, floating Translation and Broadcast buttons open panels scoped to that account
Cookie deletion and restart tests prove one account cannot affect another account
required_evidence: Unit lint build and physical-device UI evidence
Cookie isolation delete isolation restart and PSS evidence

review_records.reason: Implement user-confirmed PC-aligned application center, account list, and contextual action model
